architecture_verified.customer_data_path: Customer MT5 → AVL_FX_Bridge.ex5 → Customer Gateway → Customer Supabase ✓
architecture_verified.execution_path: AI Trader → Risk/Execution Safety → Customer Gateway → AVL_FX_Bridge.ex5 → Customer MT5 ✓

A_connection.notes: Auth headers on all requests, heartbeat with exponential backoff, reconnect detection, disconnect signal

B_realtime_tick.notes: Tick throttling via GetTickCount, sends to /market-data/tick

B_realtime_ohlc.notes: shift=1 excludes forming bar, Module_B_SendBar returns bool, failure anchors recovery cursor + sets g_BackfillNeeded

C_historical_backfill.notes: Pre-init cursors from DB watermarks in OnInit before EventSetTimer. Recovery cursor independent of realtime g_LastBarTimes. CopyRates time-range form (forward). barsAccepted-based cursor advancement. Partial accept stops pagination.

D_symbol_spec.notes: Sends on connect + 5-min refresh. Includes contractSize, volume, tick, point, digits, stopsLevel, spread

E_account.notes: Included in heartbeat payload: balance, equity, margin, freeMargin, leverage

F_positions.notes: Complete snapshot with snapshot_complete:true, all position fields including PnL, commission, swap

G_deals.notes: Initial full sync + periodic 1-day incremental. commandId linked for execution-originated deals.

H_execution.notes: 7-check safety chain: idempotency → expiry → tradingEnabled → emergencyStop → atomic claim → symbol presence → magic range. SL required. Filling mode per-symbol. Magic number range enforced.

regression_checklist.realtime_ohlc_vs_backfill_race: PASS — g_RecoveryCursor pre-initialized before EventSetTimer; Module B failure anchors cursor at g_LastSuccessSentTime before Module B advances g_LastBarTimes
regression_checklist.recovery_cursor: PASS — per-TF, independent of DB watermark, advances only on confirmed accepted batches
regression_checklist.db_watermark_advancement: PASS — Module B advances DB watermark; Module C uses cursor independently
regression_checklist.successful_bar_send_tracking: PASS — g_LastSuccessSentTime[] initialized and updated on HTTP 200/201
regression_checklist.bars_accepted_handling: PASS — parses 'accepted' from response JSON, uses for cursor position; partial accept stops pagination
regression_checklist.copy_rates_direction: PASS — uses time-range CopyRates(from, to) for FORWARD fetch; count-based form avoids backward direction
regression_checklist.copy_rates_error_vs_empty: PASS — n<0 (error) retains cursor; n==0 (empty range) clears cursor as complete
regression_checklist.forming_candle_exclusion: PASS — shift=1 in Module B; formingOpen from iTime(sym,tf,0) in Module C
regression_checklist.mn1_calendar_boundary: ACCEPTABLE — TF_ToSeconds(MN1)=2592000 (30d approx); boundedTo uses MathMin(toTime,...) where toTime uses actual formingOpen not approx; gap detection may be slightly conservative for 31d months but dedup is idempotent
regression_checklist.heartbeat_monotonic_timing: PASS — GetTickCount() throughout OnTimer; not TimeCurrent()
regression_checklist.symbol_spec_refresh: PASS — SYMBOL_SPEC_REFRESH_SEC=300, g_Connected check, re-sent on reconnect
regression_checklist.execution_polling_independence: PASS — g_LastPollTick separate; Module H always runs in OnTimer regardless of market data failures
regression_checklist.utc_conversion: PASS — UTC = broker_time - utcOffsetHours*3600; TimeTradeServer()-TimeGMT() for offset
regression_checklist.time_trade_server_time_gmt: PASS — TimeTradeServer() for reliable broker offset; TimeGMT() for current UTC

security_review.authentication: PASS — X-Connection-Id + X-Connection-Token on all requests
security_review.demo_only_guard: PASS — InpDemoOnly=true default; rejects REAL accounts at OnInit
security_review.command_expiry: PASS — checked before execution; expired commands return EXPIRED result
security_review.atomic_claim: PASS — gateway claim endpoint prevents race; NOT marked processed on transient claim failure
security_review.trading_enabled_gate: PASS — g_TradingEnabled=false default; blocks all execution
security_review.symbol_resolution: PASS — SymbolSelect validation + broker suffix resolution for canonical names
security_review.customer_isolation: PASS — all requests use X-Connection-Id scoped to single customer connection

failure_semantics.gateway_down: Heartbeat fails → g_Connected=false, g_TradingEnabled=false, g_EmergencyStop=true — safe closed state
failure_semantics.market_data_send_fail: g_BackfillNeeded=true set; cursor anchored at last confirmed send; recovered next timer tick
failure_semantics.backfill_send_fail: cursor unchanged; retry from same position next timer tick
failure_semantics.copyrates_error: n<0: retain cursor, retry next tick; n==0: recovery complete
failure_semantics.command_claim_fail: NOT marked processed; retried on next poll
failure_semantics.execution_fail: MT5 retcode logged; FAILED result sent to gateway; position sync triggered
